title: Local injectivity of the constant module Hom comparison
statement: Let (C,J) be a small site, Λ a commutative ring, M a finitely generated Λ-module, and N any Λ-module. For the constant module functor F [def-sf-site-constant-module-functor], the canonical map const(HomΛ(M,N))→H(F(M),F(N)) [lem-sf-local-module-hom-sheaf] sending a map to its induced sheaf map on every slice is locally injective.

source.place: Tag 093T, proof of (1), equality of maps checked on finitely many generators.

proof.text: Suppose constant module maps a,b induce equal local sheaf maps over U. Evaluate their equality on η_M(x) at U/U. Naturality of the unit gives η_N(a(x))=η_N(b(x)) for every x.

For a finite generating set s of M, the equality sieve of a(x) and b(x) is covering for every x in s by local injectivity of η_N. Take their finite intersection. Every arrow there forces equality on all generators in the constant presheaf. LinearMap.ext_on makes a=b, so the intersection is contained in their equality sieve, which is therefore covering.
